title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Caleb Williams efficient in Week 6 win over Falcons
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-36 pass attempts for 305 yards and one touchdown while also rushing four times for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Williams was impactful in his return to the lineup for head coach Ben Johnson, surpassing 300 passing yards for the first time in his three contests while battling a hamstring injury. The dual-threat signal-caller remains a dynamic lineup option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone twice in Week 6 win over Falcons
items.desc: D'Andre Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of his six contests. The running back will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Luther Burden III leads pass-catchers in Week 6 win over Falcons
items.desc: Luther Burden III hauled in all eight of his targets for 95 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Burden III has made the most of increased involvement in the passing attack of late, finishing with four or more receptions in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of many pass-catching options that have flashed impactful ability for head coach Ben Johnson, with a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rome Odunze quiet in Week 6 win over Falcons
items.desc: Rome Odunze caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a sizeable impact in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 50 receiving yards in four of the last five contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust for fantasy managers in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Colston Loveland finds end zone in Week 6 win
items.desc: Colston Loveland hauled in six of his seven targets for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Loveland has made the most of increased opportunities in the Chicago passing attack of late, recording four or more receptions in three of the last four contests. The tight end will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Roschon Johnson leads backfield in Week 6 win
items.desc: Roschon Johnson carried the ball 13 times for a team-high 51 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 34 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Johnson made the most of increased touches in the Chicago offense, finishing with over 40 offensive yards for the first time this season. The running back remains more of a handcuff option as part of a Chicago backfield led by D'Andre Swift and missing Kyle Monangai, with a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Patriots D/ST solid in Week 6
items.desc: The Patriots D/ST allowed 252 passing yards, 97 rushing yards, and 19 points in a win over the Jets.
items.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied three sacks and forced the first interception of the season for Geno Smith. The Patriots' defense will take on a high-powered Bears' offense in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Andy Borregales makes two field goals in Week 6
items.desc: Andy Borregales connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 2-of-3 extra point attempts in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Borregales missed his first extra point of the season, but connected on field goals from 27 and 32 yards out to help pace the Patriots to their fourth win of the year. Borregales and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Hunter Henry hits pay dirt in Week 6 win
items.desc: Hunter Henry caught 4-of-5 targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Henry has found the endzone in two consecutive games and logged at least four targets or more in four of his last five games. Henry remains a trustworthy option heading into a Week 7 matchup with the Bears.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: DeMario Douglas finds the end zone in Week 6 win
items.desc: DeMario Douglas caught 7-of-8 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Douglas led the team in receptions and receiving yards and found the end zone for the second straight game. If Rome Doubs (shoulder) is forced to miss any time, Douglas will likely see an increase in playing time. The Patriots take on the Bears Thursday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) finds the end zone in Week 6
items.desc: Romeo Doubs caught his lone target for a 42-yard touchdown in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Doubs suffered the injury on the touchdown catch in which he landed hard diving for the ball. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of a Thursday night matchup with the Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kalif Raymond quiet in Week 6 win
items.desc: Kalif Raymond caught both of his targets for 18 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Raymond has fallen back to earth after a scorching start to the season, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in each of the last three contests. The wideout remains one of the more streaky pass-catching options in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: A.J. Brown hauls in three passes in Week 6 win
items.desc: A.J. Brown caught 3-of-10 targets for 27 yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Brown struggled with drops Sunday, logging three drops in his return to action after a Week 1 ankle injury. Brown and the Patriots play on Thursday, so it is a quick turnaround for the veteran to knock off any additional rust heading into Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson logs eight touches in Week 6 win
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson rushed for 31 yards on seven carries in the 26-19 win over the Jets. He caught his lone target for nine yards.
items.impact: Henderson returned from a high-ankle sprain that he suffered last week, but saw Corey Kiner run the ball more Sunday. Henderson did fumble the ball to the Jets, which likely impacted his playing time late in the game. Henderson and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson quiet in Week 6 win
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 36 yards on 14 carries in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Stevenson was not involved in the passing game and logged just 2.6 yards per carry on the day. The Patriots gave a total of 18 carries to Corey Kiner and TreVeyon Henderson, limiting Stevenson's chances against the Jets. Stevenson and the Patriots will take on the Bears next week.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 18-of-32 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns in a 26-19 win over the Jets. Maye added 24 rushing yards on four carries.
items.impact: Maye found DeMario Douglas, Hunter Henry, and Romeo Doubs for his three touchdown passes. Maye turned another spotless performance, logging two straight games without a turnover after throwing seven seven interceptions in the first four games. Maye and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jets D/ST allows 26 points in Week 6 loss
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 235 passing yards, 148 rushing yards, and 26 points in a loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: The Jets' defense failed to record a sack or interception in the game, but did recover two fumbles in the loss. The Jets' defense are a solid streaming option in Week 7 against Miami.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jason Sanders perfect in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Jason Sanders made 4-of-4 field goals and 1-of-1 extra points in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Sanders connected on field goals from 36, 36, 40, and 42 yards out to help pace the Jets in Sunday's loss. Sanders has missed just one kick this season so far. Sanders and the Jets will take on the Dolphins in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zavion Thomas sees three targets in Week 6
items.desc: Zavion Thomas caught all three of his targets for 25 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: Thomas has been a non-factor in the Chicago offense to this point, finishing with less than 30 receiving yards in each of the first six contests. The pass-catcher remains best left out of lineups in all formats ahead of a Week 7 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mason Taylor hauls in four passes in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught 4-of-6 targets for 33 yards in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Taylor led the tight end group in receptions, yards, and targets. Taylor and Kenyon Sadiq should be expected to continue to split time heading into Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq records one reception in Week 6
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Sadiq returned from a concussion that he suffered in Week 5, but was not a featured part of the offense. Mason Taylor saw six targets to Sadiq's three, so both appear to be involved in the offense heading into Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cole Kmet catches two passes in Week 6
items.desc: Cole Kmet caught both of his targets for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: Kmet has been an afterthought in the offense of late, recording less than 15 receiving yards in each of the last five contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats until further notice, with a Week 7 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 6-of-7 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Cooper led the team in all receiving categories in the loss Sunday. Cooper had been out of action for the last four games with a high-ankle sprain. Cooper will look to continue to build rapport with QB Geno Smith in Week 7 against Miami.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bears D/ST records five sacks in Week 6
items.desc: The Bears D/ST recorded five sacks while also forcing three turnovers (three fumble recoveries) in a 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: The defense was able to keep the Atlanta offense mostly in check, allowing 257 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Garrett Wilson hauls in four passes in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Garrett Wilson caught 4-of-6 targets for 44 yards in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Wilson turned in his second lowest output of the season in the loss Sunday. Despite the performance Sunday, Wilson remains the top fantasy option heading into a Week 7 matchup with Miami.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Isaiah Davis tallies eight touches in Week 6
items.desc: Isaiah Davis rushed for 16 yards on seven carries in the 26-19 loss to the Patriots. He caught his lone target for 10 yards.
items.impact: Davis continues to operate as the RB2 behind Braelon Allen with Breece Hall out injured. Fantasy mangers can leave Davis on the waiver wire heading into Week 7 against Miami.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Braelon Allen sees 19 touches in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Braelon Allen rushed for 78 yards on 17 carries in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for 26 yards.
items.impact: Allen continued to see the bulk of the carries for the Jets with Breece Hall (quad) out injured. Fantasy managers should expect Allen to continue to operate as the Jets' RB1 if Hall is not cleared to return against Miami next week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cairo Santos misses field goal in Week 6
items.desc: Cairo Santos converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as one of two field goal attempts to finish with seven points in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: Santos continues to take advantage of his opportunities behind a productive Chicago offense, recording seven or more points in four of six contests. The kicker will look for another reliable performance in Week 7 against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Geno Smith tosses one touchdown in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Geno Smith completed 20-of-30 pass attempts for 252 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Smith connected with Omar Cooper Jr. on a deep pass for the Jets' lone passing touchdown of the day. Smith spread the ball around effectively and was intercepted for the first time this season. The Jets and Smith will take on Miami at home in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jaguars D/ST allows 34 points in Week 6 loss
items.desc: The Jaguars D/ST allowed 312 passing yards, 114 rushing yards, and 34 points in a loss to Houston.
items.impact: The Jaguars' defense tallied one interception, but failed to record a sack. The defense has been solid all season and will look to regroup in their bye week before taking on the Colts in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Cam Little perfect in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Cam Little connected on his lone field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-31 loss to Houston.
items.impact: Little connected on a 60-yard field goal for his lone make of the day. Little has missed just one kick this season and continues to show that he has one of the strongest legs in the game. Little and the Jaguars will head to their bye in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Brenton Strange catches five passes in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Brenton Strange caught 5-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the 34-31 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Strange continues to lead the tight end group for the Jaguars. The 25-year-old has logged three straight games with at least five receptions. Strange and the Jaguars will head to the bye in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Bijan Robinson bottled up in Week 6 loss to Bears
items.desc: Bijan Robinson carried the ball nine times for 61 yards while also catching both of his targets for a loss of eight yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Robinson struggled to make an impact out of the backfield, recording less than 70 offensive yards for the first time in six contests. The running back remains locked in as a strong RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 loss to Bears
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. completed 19-of-33 pass attempts for 225 yards and three touchdowns while rushing once for one yard and losing a fumble in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Penix Jr. has been mostly reliable behind center in his return to the lineup, throwing for one or more touchdowns in each of his last three contests. The quarterback remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Drake London sees 10 targets in Week 6 loss to Bears
items.desc: Drake London hauled in four of his team-leading 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: London continues to make the most of his role as the primary option in an inconsistent Atlanta passing attack, registering 10 or more targets in three of the last four contests. The wideout will look to make a more explosive impact in a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. sees four touches in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. rushed twice for one yard while also catching both of his targets for nine yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6.
items.impact: Robinson Jr. has fallen back to earth of late, recording less than 20 offensive yards in each of the last two games. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Travis Hunter hits pay dirt in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Travis Hunter caught 4-of-4 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Jacksonville's 34-31 loss to Houston.
items.impact: Hunter had an amazing day on both sides of the ball, also tallying three tackles and an interception on defense. He set new season highs in receptions, yards, and scored his first touchdown of the season. He should how versatile he can be on offense, so it would not be a surprise to see the Jaguars attempt to get him more involved in the offense after the bye week.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in two touchdowns in Week 6 loss to Bears
items.desc: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in five of his seven targets for 60 yards and two touchdowns in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Pitts Sr. has made the most of the return of quarterback Michael Penix Jr., recording five receptions and one or more touchdowns in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the primary pass-catching options for head coach Kevin Stefanski as long as Penix Jr. is behind center ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jahan Dotson finds end zone in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Jahan Dotson hauled in three of his five targets for 87 yards and one touchdown in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Dotson has made the most of his opportunities in the Atlanta passing offense of late, finishing with over 50 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout will look to offer head coach another stable pass-catching option moving forward, with a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. vanishes in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. was held without a catch on two targets in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Thomas has now been held without a catch in two consecutive games, and did not see an offensive snap after halftime. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable benching Thomas, or at least moving on when the Jaguars return after their Week 7 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zachariah Branch catches two passes in Week 6
items.desc: Zachariah Branch caught both of his targets for nine yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6.
items.impact: Branch has been a non-factor in the Atlanta offense to this point, finishing with less than 20 receiving yards in each of the first six contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jakobi Meyers hauls in five passes in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught 5-of-10 targets for 83 yards in a 34-31 loss to Houston.
items.impact: Meyers lead the team in catches and receiving Sunday, falling just one target behind Parker Washington for the team lead. The veteran turned in his best performance of the season so far and will look to build on that after their bye week in Week 7.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Parker Washington held to four receptions in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Parker Washington caught 4-of-11 targets for 64 yards in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
items.impact: Washington led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them. He finished behind Jakobi Meyers in receptions and receiving yards in the loss, and could not find the end zone despite Trevor Lawrence tossing four touchdowns. Washington will look to rest up in the bye week and bounce back in Week 8.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. sees 11 carries in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. rushed for 55 yards on 11 carries in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to Houston. He did not record a reception on his lone target.
items.impact: Rodriguez tallied a better yards per carry average than Bhayshul Tuten, but Tuten was able to get more involved in the passing game. Fantasy managers should expect Tuten to continue to see the bulk of the playing time coming out of the Week 7 bye.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Olamide Zaccheaus sees four targets in Week 6
items.desc: Olamide Zaccheaus failed to catch any of his four targets in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6.
items.impact: Zaccheaus has struggled to make an impact to this point, posting two receptions or less in each of the first six contests. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten hits pay dirt twice in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten rushed for 39 yards on 12 carries in the 34-31 loss to the Texans. He caught 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns.
items.impact: Tuten did have a rushing touchdown called back on a holding call, limiting his rushing output. His two touchdowns receptions marked his first receiving touchdowns of the season, and is a good sign for him being more involved in the passing game in the future. Tuten and the Jaguars will head to the bye in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Austin Hooper catches pass in Week 6
items.desc: Austin Hooper caught his only target for six yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6.
items.impact: Hooper has seen minimal involvement in the Atlanta passing attack to this point, logging two targets or less in five of six contests. the tight end can remain off rosters in all formats as long as Kyle Pitts remains healthy ahead of a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Trevor Lawrence tosses four touchdowns in Week 6 loss
items.desc: Trevor Lawrence completed 24-of-41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in a 34-31 loss to Houston. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
items.impact: Lawrence and the Jaguars' offense turned heavily to the passing game in the second half after falling behind Houston early. Lawrence was able to top 300 yards passing for the second straight game and set a new season high in passing attempts. Lawrence and the Jaguars will head to a bye in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Falcons D/ST forces turnover in Week 6
items.desc: The Falcons D/ST forced one turnover (one fumble recovery) while also registering four sacks in a 31-23 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 6.
items.impact: The defense was unable to slow down a returning Caleb Williams, allowing over 300 yards through the air in the loss. The unit faces another productive offense in a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Texans D/ST allows 31 points in Week 6 win
items.desc: The Texans D/ST allowed 306 passing yards, 106 rushing yards, and 31 points in a win over Jacksonville.
items.impact: The Texans' defense forced one interception, but tallied no sacks against Trevor Lawrence and the Jaguars. The Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.
